result.summary: Extract a common block validation state catcher into a new header node/block_validation_state_catcher.h. Replace duplicate implementations across the block template manager, the submitblock RPC, and mining test helpers, standardizing on std::optional to track captured validation states.
result.problem: Multiple callers independently implement duplicate validation event listener classes to capture BlockValidationState results, creating redundant code and minor inconsistencies in how captured states are flagged.
evidence: Author notes review feedback requesting deduplication in PR #34644 (discussion_r2889315162) and PR #35675 (discussion_r360301816)
result.scope_notes: Mechanical refactoring that moves duplicate ValidationInterface listener structs into a single header.
result.card: Deduplicates the block validation state listener logic across submitblock, the block template manager, and mining test helpers into a new node/block_validation_state_catcher.h header. Multiple callers previously maintained redundant copies of the validation catcher with slight differences in state tracking. Review comments on PR #34644 and PR #35675 previously called out the need to unify this pattern.
uncertainties: The diff was not provided, so exact changes to registration lifecycles and error propagation cannot be verified directly.

risk.why: A mistake in validation state capture could cause submitblock or block template logic to misreport block validation errors or drop failure reasons.
